title: My AI Investment Operating System — Build Yours in 5 Steps
excerpt: 8 AIs debated investing philosophies across 7 experiments. This free tool turns their consensus into your personalized AI investment coaching system and Prompt Library.

Question 1 of 4

How many investing philosophies do you know?

There are 6 main schools. Before we ask what fits you, let's make sure we're on the same page.

A

1–2 — heard of them but not clear on the differences

B

3 — I know a few well

C

4–5 — pretty solid grasp

D

All 6 — I'm familiar with each one

🦅 Value Investing

Warren Buffett · Benjamin Graham

Find great businesses trading below their intrinsic value. Buy and hold for years — let compounding do the work. The "boring" approach that historically outperforms most active strategies.

📌 e.g. Coca-Cola (KO), Apple (AAPL), Berkshire (BRK.B) — durable brands, wide moats, held for decades.

📊 Index / Passive Investing

John Bogle

Don't try to beat the market — own the whole market cheaply. Dollar-cost average into index funds. Beat most professionals by doing almost nothing.

📌 e.g. SPY / VOO (S&P 500), VTI (total US market), QQQ (Nasdaq 100). Set auto-invest and ignore the noise.

🌱 Growth Investing

Philip Fisher

Find companies growing revenues and market share rapidly. Pay a premium for future dominance. Higher upside, higher volatility — patience and conviction required.

📌 e.g. NVIDIA before the AI boom, Amazon in the 2010s — high P/E, high growth, requires holding through painful drawdowns.

📈 Trend Trading

Jesse Livermore

Follow price momentum. Buy what's going up, sell what's going down, cut losses fast. Demands iron discipline — most practitioners eventually lose without a system.

📌 e.g. Bitcoin & crypto cycles, NVDA breakout in 2023. Success depends entirely on when you enter and exit.

🌐 Macro Hedge

George Soros · Ray Dalio

Trade across asset classes based on macroeconomic cycles: currencies, bonds, commodities, equities. Extremely high bar for entry — this is institutional-level complexity.

📌 e.g. Gold (GLD) as inflation hedge, TLT on rate cuts, oil on supply shocks. Soros shorted the British pound. Dalio uses All Weather.

🎯 Core-Satellite

Bogle + Buffett / Fisher hybrid

80% index for stable market beta · 20% active positions for selected upside. Structure that lets you benefit from both systematic and conviction-based investing.

📌 e.g. VOO as core + 3–5 hand-picked stocks as satellite. Separates "must not lose" from "willing to bet on."
